definition: MC(w) := ∀P : World → Prop, P(w) → ∀v, R(w,v) → P(v). Quantification includes negations and singleton identity predicates P(v) := v = w. Thus accessible equality uses built-in point separation; restricted proposition domains could have indistinguishable distinct worlds. This local predicate is not global validity or global uniqueness of worlds.
